channel.title: Montenegro passport: visa rule changes
channel.description: Destinations whose entry rule changed for Montenegro passport holders, found by the daily comparison of public visa-policy sources (mainly Wikipedia). Check the official source before you travel.

item.title: Belarus: Visa-free → Visa required
item.description: Belarus: visa-free before, visa required now, for Montenegro passport holders. Seen in the daily data check on 2 November 2026.

item.title: Solomon Islands: Visa required → eVisa
item.description: Solomon Islands: visa required before, eVisa now, for Montenegro passport holders. Seen in the daily data check on 9 October 2026.
